title: Complete contraction of unital qubit channels and order-constrained depolarization
abstract: We determine the complete equal-reference contraction coefficients of the minimal quantum Fisher metric, its quadratic chi-square divergence and the finite triangular Petz divergence for every unital qubit channel. For a faithful normalized Choi state J they equal 1-16/Tr(J inverse); for singular J they equal one. A qubit-qutrit lower family matches a harmonic-weight upper and gives an exact stabilization envelope, including a maximal factor of nine between coefficient suprema. For dimension d depolarization, a commuting Bell family matches lambda^2 kappa/[1+lambda(kappa-1)] for each normalized nonaffine operator-convex Petz generator up to kappa=d^2/2. A principal-rich rank-two ladder extends SLD and triangular sharpness to kappa=d(2d-1)/2, with actual-marginal budgets and reference dimension 2d-1. A separate logarithmic calculation yields the complete equal-reference BKM and finite Umegaki lower lambda^2 P/[1+lambda(P-1)], P=d(d-1), with a constrained profile and four interval-certified finite comparisons. We also identify qubit classical-reference and separable/PPT restrictions and give a localized Doeblin counterexample. These results do not determine unrestricted BKM, Umegaki, actual-mutual-information or capacity optima; the displayed lower is not a unitary phase model. Faithful limits, prior dependencies, adverse controls and review-context limits are explicit.
